title: Never Shake Grandpa's Snow GLOBE
premise: Grandpa Gus's snow globe makes it snow on our street and only ours, and everyone stumbles at once when it is shaken. After every snow one person-sized dry spot stays in the middle of the road and every car swerves around it. My driving test is tomorrow and I shake it for a snow day.
twist: Something far too tall has always stood in the middle of our road, the globe is the only place you can see it, and every shake moves it to somebody's door. The stumble is it brushing past everyone on its way.
world: one snowy street of nine painted houses a side, seen from Grandpa's front room and porch, with a glass snow globe on the sill
